title: IU School of Education signs memorandum of understanding with Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia
summary_en: Dean Robert Berry signed a Memorandum of Understanding that will enable qualified UPI lecturers to transfer to IU to complete a Ph.D. at the IU School of Education in Bloomington. They will also be eligible to be awarded a doctoral degree from UPI upon the successful defense of their dissertation.
